name: edgex-go-security-command-execution-evidence
instr:
Give embedders a structured, caller-visible account of security command execution, including meaningful effect boundaries, completion, and evidence-delivery failures. Apply one evidence contract to gate, genPassword, getHttpStatus, help, listen, waitFor, and createToken without changing their established effects or process-facing results.

Every `Command.ExecuteWith` invocation returns one `ExecutionReport` carrying the supplied invocation identity and concrete command name, with accepted records numbered contiguously in recorder acceptance order even under concurrency. Every completed report has exactly one terminal record whose outcome agrees with `StatusCode` and `ExecutionError`. Evidence describes effect classes and outcomes but never generated passwords, tokens, credentials, secret-bearing request values, response bodies, or filesystem contents. An `EvidenceSink` rejection never interrupts command execution or replaces its outcome; it is exposed independently as `DeliveryError`. Legacy `Execute` calls preserve existing output bytes, status, errors, delegation, blocking, and listener lifetimes. Each command reports boundaries faithful to its behavior, including gate listener exposure and readiness, HTTP transport and status, listener establishment and failure, password generation and output, delegated help, waitFor probes, and createToken secret-store and replacement work. Bootstrapper and file-provider consumers finalize and deliver the selected command's report before
